এল-সায়েদের বিজয় আবারও প্রমাণ করল, এআইপ: El-Sayed’s victory once again demonstrated that AIPAC can be defeated. It also challenged the idea that a supposedly “safe” centrist candidate must be chosen to win in a swing state.
২০২৪ সালে মধ্যপন্থী প্রার্থী এলিসা স্লটক: El-Sayed defeated Rogers by a much wider margin than centrist candidate Elissa Slotkin achieved in 2024. Although El-Sayed does not describe himself as a democratic socialist, he supports Bernie Sanders and belongs to the Democratic Party’s progressive wing. He favours public health insurance for everyone through Medicare for All and has co-authored a book on the subject.
ম্যাট ইয়েগলেসিয়াসের মতো ভাষ্যকারদের যু: Commentators such as Matt Yglesias argue that centrism is advantageous in elections because it places a candidate nearer the median voter’s political position. Robinson argues, however, that this result shows how addressing voters’ real problems and incorporating their anger and frustration at injustice into a political position can provide electoral strength.
২০১৬ সাল থেকেই কারেন্ট অ্যাফেয়ার্স এই য: Current Affairs has advanced this argument since 2016. That year, the magazine argued that Bernie Sanders might have been a stronger candidate than Hillary Clinton in states such as Michigan. Robinson sees El-Sayed’s victory as support for the argument that “Bernie would have won,” and questions the need to nominate corporate-oriented Democrats.
বার্নি স্যান্ডার্সের আন্দোলনের বীজ বিকশি: Robinson expresses pleasure at seeing the seeds of Bernie Sanders’s movement develop. Since 2016, the magazine has worked as part of a democratic-socialist movement. Initially, they felt marginalised, and Sanders’s defeats in two presidential nomination contests were discouraging.
তাঁর মতে, সেই প্রচারাভিযানগুলো অনেক মানু: In his account, those campaigns helped form many people politically. They are determined to work against oligarchic domination, the military-industrial complex, hatred, and authoritarianism.
সম্প্রতি গ্রাহকদের সঙ্গে জুমে চা-আড্ডায়: They were recently pleased to hear Matt Gile’s experience during a Zoom tea gathering with subscribers. Robinson writes that the magazine played a part in this democratic socialist’s political development and that he was elected to the Vermont State Senate. [Editorial note: independent verification of this office-related claim has not been completed; it is retained as the author’s claim.]
রবিনসনের যুক্তি, আন্দোলন সফল করতে আরও মা: Robinson argues that successful movements need media capable of persuading more people to support them. Over ten years, they have built a publication making the case for progressive politics. To him, writers and subscribers becoming elected representatives illustrates the importance of independent media.
এটি মতামতমূলক লেখা। একটি নির্বাচনে জয় “: This is an opinion essay. A victory in one election can refute the categorical claim that “progressive candidates can never win,” but it does not establish that centrists always perform worse or prove the counterfactual that Sanders would certainly have won in 2016. National conditions, turnout, opponents, and campaigns change between elections.
